context: Portfolio for AI Engineer in Healthcare Genomics (Kartik Pal). Needs to wow recruiters with Anthropic/Linear level polish, dark AI lab aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#030712]/70 border-b border-white/10 shadow-sm
surface_strategies.cards: Retro-Futurism/Technical Grid: Flat #111827 background, 1px border-white/10. Hover: border-cyan-500/50 with subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)]
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: bg-cyan-500 text-black font-semibold hover:bg-cyan-400. Secondary: border border-white/20 bg-transparent text-white hover:bg-white/5
surface_strategies.bento_items: Use 'Tracing Beam' concept or subtle glows on borders.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit text color changes, subtle translateY(-2px), glow effects on borders.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid and timeline items.
motion_and_interactions.special: Number ticker for '95L', '91%', '7'. Typewriter effect or smooth reveal for chatbot.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow, monospace editorial ribbon for tech stack (LLM, MLOps, AWS, GCP, etc.)

components_needed.hero: Left aligned text with glowing gradient/noise background or the generated AI Genomics visual as a subtle background (opacity max 40%). Tagline: 'AI Engineer / Data Scientist'. Name: 'Kartik Pal'.
components_needed.stats_counter: Animated numbers row. Items: '₹95L funding raised', '91% Top-5 accuracy', '2+ yrs exp', '7 production systems'.
components_needed.chatbot: 'Ask Kartik's AI' - sticky widget or bento card using Shadcn dialog/popover, simulating Gemini 3 Flash.
components_needed.projects_bento: Showcasing VUSPredict, TxGNN, RarePredict, Genomic Variant Explanation Agent. Use varying spans (col-span-4, col-span-8).
components_needed.timeline: Experience & Publications (Elsevier book chapter). Left border line with glowing dots.
components_needed.contact: Hire-me form (Shadcn forms) + Download CV button + LinkedIn link.

hero_ai_genomics.description: Abstract 3D glowing neural network intertwined with a DNA double helix. Use as hero background or prominent bento card visual. Blend with overlay bg-[#030712]/60.

background_texture.description: Dark futuristic abstract texture. Use as a subtle noise/texture overlay for the entire page or specific sections.

project_bento_1.description: Abstract representation of data pipelines in a dark lab setting. Use as thumbnail for one of the major projects (e.g., Serverless AWS Genomic Infrastructure or VUSPredict).

icons.instructions: Use minimal, stroke-based icons. For tech stack, use text labels or SVG icons if available, otherwise rely on clean typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Framer Motion and use it for staggered reveals and number counters.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main bento grid to achieve E1's asymmetry and overlaps, avoiding rigid Shadcn layouts for the core structure.
Use Shadcn UI for the Chatbot, Forms, and Buttons.
Strictly follow the typography scale. Do not exceed text-6xl for the hero.
Ensure all text has APCA/WCAG compliant contrast, especially over images.
Do not use default generic blue. Use the provided Cyan/Laser Green for accents.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
